title: tidyhwsd: tidy access to HWSD v2.0
text: tidyhwsd provides tidyverse-friendly interface Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD) v2.0. keeps terra objects performance uses snake_case arguments tibble outputs point queries.

title: tidyhwsd: tidy access to HWSD v2.0
text: HWSD index grid (HWSD2.bil) shipped package. Download writable directory: can set WS_PATH ~/.Renviron make path persistent sessions:
code: # Replace with your preferred path hwsd_download(ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2", verbose = TRUE) WS_PATH=~/data/HWSD2

title: tidyhwsd: tidy access to HWSD v2.0
text: Multiple points can provided data frame:
code: pt <- hwsd_extract(   coords = c(110, 40),   param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2" ) sites <- data.frame(   lon = c(120, 121.5),   lat = c(30, 31.2) ) pt_multi <- hwsd_extract(   coords = sites,   param = "SAND",   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2" ) pt_multi

title: tidyhwsd: tidy access to HWSD v2.0
text: hwsd_extract() returns dominant-component values default. share-weighted composition, use hwsd_compose() rules hwsd_props():

what: Data model (from the HWSD v2.0 manual)
title: HWSD v2.0 units and aggregation
text: HWSD v2.0 stores soil information per soil mapping unit (SMU). SMU can 12 components, : SEQUENCE: order components (sequence 1 dominant) SHARE: percent share, summed 100 within SMU LAYER: D1 D7 depth layers hwsd2_layers component table; hwsd_extract() hwsd_compose() map SMU IDs attributes using fields.

title: HWSD v2.0 units and aggregation
text: hwsd_props() provides description default aggregation rule property, plus precision field encodes rounding step used aggregation. Common units (manual field definitions): Depth: TOPDEP, BOTDEP cm (D1 = 0-20 cm; …; D7 = 150-200 cm) Texture: SAND, SILT, CLAY percent weight Bulk density: BULK, REF_BULK g/cm3 Organic carbon: ORG_CARBON percent weight pH: PH_WATER water (-log(H+)) Total nitrogen: TOTAL_N g/kg CEC / ECEC / TEB: cmol/kg Electrical conductivity: ELEC_COND dS/m AWC: AWC mm/m (see manual table USDA texture classes) Code fields: ROOT_DEPTH class code (1-4; deep shallow) ROOTS, IL, SWR class codes (see manual) DRAINAGE categorical class

title: HWSD v2.0 units and aggregation
text: hwsd_extract() returns dominant component values: SEQUENCE = 1 preferred within SEQUENCE = 1, largest SHARE chosen SEQUENCE = 1 exists, largest SHARE chosen hwsd_compose() performs share-weighted synthesis using rules hwsd_props(): numeric fields: weighted_mean categorical fields: weighted_mode ID-like fields: drop numeric outputs rounded precision step Example:
code: props <- hwsd_props() props$agg[props$property == "PH_WATER"] <- "dominant"  pt_dom <- hwsd_extract(   coords = c(110, 40),   param = c("PH_WATER", "SAND"),   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2" )  pt_syn <- hwsd_compose(   coords = c(110, 40),   param = c("PH_WATER", "SAND"),   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2",   props = props )

title: Tidy Interface to HWSD v2.0 Data
text: HWSD 2.0 component-based soil association dataset: single SMU x layer can contain multiple components, SEQUENCE SHARE. previous pre-collapsed table obscured structure forced implicit choices (e.g., dominant-). version uses component table single source truth exposes explicit aggregation options (dominant vs. share-weighted, categorical mode vs. distribution). Defaults remain reasonable compatible prior behavior, enabling transparent, configurable analysis.

title: Tidy Interface to HWSD v2.0 Data
text: Download HWSD index grid . directory created needed. Point query. Returns dominant component values. Optional: share-weighted synthesis per-variable rules: Multiple points can provided data frame tibble: Bounding box query. Returns SpatRaster; tiling improves performance large areas. Categorical data extraction (e.g., Drainage Class). Returns factor raster labels: Discover available properties:
code: library(tidyhwsd)  # Replace with your preferred path, or set WS_PATH in ~/.Renviron hwsd_download(ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2", verbose = TRUE) pt <- hwsd_extract(   coords = c(110, 40),   param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2" ) props <- hwsd_props() pt_syn <- hwsd_compose(   coords = c(110, 40),   param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2",   props = props ) sites <- data.frame(   lon = c(120, 121.5),   lat = c(30, 31.2) ) pt_multi <- hwsd_extract(   coords = sites,   param = "SAND",   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2" ) sand <- hwsd_extract(   bbox = c(70, 18, 140, 54),   param = "SAND",   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2",   tiles_deg = 5,   cores = 4,   internal = TRUE ) terra::plot(sand) drainage <- hwsd_extract(   bbox = c(110, 30, 112, 32),   param = "DRAINAGE",   layer = "D1",   ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2" ) terra::plot(drainage) hwsd_props()

title: Extract HWSD v2.0 attributes (dominant component) — hwsd_extract
text: Dominant component selection follows: prefer SEQUENCE = 1 present; within SEQUENCE = 1 choose largest SHARE; SEQUENCE = 1 exists, choose largest SHARE (ties break smallest SEQUENCE available). share-weighted synthesis, use hwsd_compose().

title: tidyhwsd 0.2.0
text: Default extraction returns dominant components match legacy behavior. Added composition workflow via hwsd_compose() aggregation rules hwsd_props(). Expanded property metadata precision clarified units. Updated documentation examples reflect dominant vs. composed outputs.
